## `ros2_action_request_result`

> Mutation status: unknown (safety classification not available in this build).

Wait for the RESULT of a ROS 2 action (GetResult) for a given goal_id. Before **every** use of this tool, the agent should ensure the target action exists (e.g., by calling 'ros2_list_actions').

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action_name` | string | yes | Action name, e.g. '/fibonacci' |
| `action_type` | string | yes | Full action type, e.g. 'example_interfaces/action/Fibonacci' or 'pkg/ActionName' |
| `goal_id_hex` | string | yes | 32-char UUID hex of the goal (no dashes). |
| `timeout_sec` | number \| null | no | Seconds to wait for GetResult; null → wait indefinitely. · default: `60.0` |
| `wait_for_service_sec` | number | no | Seconds to wait for the GetResult service to appear. · default: `3.0` |

## `ros2_action_subscribe_feedback`

> Mutation status: unknown (safety classification not available in this build).

| `duration_sec` | number | no | How many seconds to keep spinning and collecting feedback. · default: `5.0` |
| `goal_id_hex` | string \| null | no | Optional 32-char UUID hex of the goal (no dashes) to filter feedbacks. |

## `ros2_cancel_action_goal`

> Mutation status: unknown (safety classification not available in this build).

Cancel a ROS 2 action goal via '/<action>/cancel_goal' (action_msgs/srv/CancelGoal). You can cancel a specific goal by goal_id_hex or cancel all matching goals using cancel_all=True. Optionally limit cancellation to goals accepted before a given stamp (sec/nanosec). Before **every** use of this tool, the agent should ensure the target action exists (e.g., by calling 'ros2_list_actions').

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action_name` | string | yes | Action name, e.g. '/fibonacci' or '/navigate_to_pose' |
| `cancel_all` | boolean | no | If true, send zero-UUID to cancel all matching goals. · default: `false` |
| `goal_id_hex` | string | no | 32-char UUID hex of the goal (no dashes). Omit when cancel_all=True. |
| `stamp_nanosec` | integer | no | Nanoseconds part for the acceptance time filter. · default: `0` |
| `stamp_sec` | integer | no | Cancel goals accepted BEFORE this sec (default 0 → usually all). · default: `0` |
| `wait_timeout_sec` | number | no | Timeout (seconds) to wait for the service and response. · default: `3.0` |

<details><summary>Input schema (JSON)</summary>

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "action_name": {
      "description": "Action name, e.g. '/fibonacci' or '/navigate_to_pose'",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "cancel_all": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, send zero-UUID to cancel all matching goals.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "goal_id_hex": {
      "description": "32-char UUID hex of the goal (no dashes). Omit when cancel_all=True.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "stamp_nanosec": {
      "default": 0,
      "description": "Nanoseconds part for the acceptance time filter.",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "stamp_sec": {
      "default": 0,
      "description": "Cancel goals accepted BEFORE this sec (default 0 → usually all).",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "wait_timeout_sec": {
      "default": 3.0,
      "description": "Timeout (seconds) to wait for the service and response.",
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "action_name"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

## `ros2_send_action_goal`

> Mutation status: unknown (safety classification not available in this build).

Send a goal to a ROS 2 action by name and action type using provided goal fields. Before **every** use of this tool, the agent must call 'ros2_list_actions' and 'ros2_interface_list' to ensure the latest available actions and types are known. Optionally wait for the result with a timeout.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action_name` | string | yes | Action name, e.g. '/fibonacci' or '/navigate_to_pose' |
| `action_type` | string | yes | Full action type, e.g. 'example_interfaces/action/Fibonacci' or 'pkg/ActionName' |
| `goal_fields` | object | yes | Dictionary with goal message fields (1st section of .action file) |
| `timeout_sec` | number | no | Timeout (seconds) for waiting on the result when wait_for_result=true · default: `60.0` |
| `wait_for_result` | boolean | no | If true, wait for GetResult and include final status/result · default: `false` |

## `ros2_stream_start`

> Mutation status: unknown (safety classification not available in this build).

Start a keep-latest stream session for a ROS 2 topic (Image/CompressedImage/PointCloud2/Generic). Returns a session_id. UI/App-only tool.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jpeg_quality` | integer | no | default: `80` |
| `kind` | string | yes | one of: `"image"`, `"pointcloud"`, `"message"` |
| `max_height` | integer | no | default: `540` |
| `max_points` | integer | no | Max points to return; <=0 means no limit. · default: `0` |
| `max_width` | integer | no | default: `960` |
| `qos_preset` | string | no | QoS preset for the stream subscription. Use sensor_data for most camera topics. · one of: `"auto"`, `"sensor_data"`, `"system_default"` · default: `"auto"` |
| `target_fps` | number | no | Soft cap for processing frames (keep-latest, drops when over). · default: `20.0` |
| `topic_name` | string | yes |  |

<details><summary>Input schema (JSON)</summary>

```json
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {

      "default": 80,

      ],

        "system_default"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "target_fps": {
      "default": 20.0,
      "description": "Soft cap for processing frames (keep-latest, drops when over).",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "topic_name": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },

}
```

## `ros2_topic_publish`

> Mutation status: unknown (safety classification not available in this build).

Publish a message to a ROS 2 topic by name and message type using provided field values.
            Supports single publish (default) or continuous publishing at a specified frequency for a duration.
            Before **every** use of this tool, the agent must call 'ros2_topic_list' and 'ros2_interface_list'
            to ensure the latest available topics and message types are known.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | yes | Dictionary containing the message fields and values |
| `duration` | number | no | Optional: Duration in seconds for continuous publishing. Must be used with frequency parameter. |
| `frequency` | number | no | Optional: Publish frequency in Hz (messages per second). If provided with duration, publishes repeatedly. |
| `message_type` | string | yes | Full ROS 2 message type, e.g., 'std_msgs/msg/String' |
| `topic_name` | string | yes | Name of the topic to publish to |

<details><summary>Input schema (JSON)</summary>

```json
{
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "description": "Dictionary containing the message fields and values",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "duration": {
      "description": "Optional: Duration in seconds for continuous publishing. Must be used with frequency parameter.",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "frequency": {
      "description": "Optional: Publish frequency in Hz (messages per second). If provided with duration, publishes repeatedly.",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "message_type": {
      "description": "Full ROS 2 message type, e.g., 'std_msgs/msg/String'",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "topic_name": {
      "description": "Name of the topic to publish to",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
```

> Mutation status: unknown (safety classification not available in this build).

            Before **every** use of this tool, the agent must call 'ros2_topic_list'
            to ensure it has the latest available topics

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | number | no | If provided, collects messages for this many seconds. |
| `message_limit` | integer | no | If provided, stops after receiving this number of messages. |
| `topic_name` | string | yes | Name of the topic to subscribe to |

<details><summary>Input schema (JSON)</summary>

```json
{
  "properties": {
    "duration": {
      "description": "If provided, collects messages for this many seconds.",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "message_limit": {
      "description": "If provided, stops after receiving this number of messages.",
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "topic_name": {
      "description": "Name of the topic to subscribe to",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "topic_name"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

## `ros2_viewer_app`

> Mutation status: unknown (safety classification not available in this build).

Open an interactive ROS 2 viewer app (Image + PointCloud2 + Plot) for MCP clients that support Apps/HTML resources.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auto_start` | boolean | no | default: `true` |
| `plot_fields` | array<string> | no | Optional list of plot field paths to preselect in Plot mode. |
| `preferred_kind` | string | no | one of: `"image"`, `"pointcloud"`, `"plot"`, `"auto"` |
| `topic_name` | string | no |  |

<details><summary>Input schema (JSON)</summary>

```json
{
  "properties": {
    "auto_start": {
      "default": true,
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "plot_fields": {
      "description": "Optional list of plot field paths to preselect in Plot mode.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "type": "array"
    },
    "preferred_kind": {
      "enum": [
        "image",
        "pointcloud",
        "plot",
        "auto"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "topic_name": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>
